title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | PASS-OFF ENGLISH | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ PASSOFF- 104 ]

blocks.text: Every night when I get home, I chat on the computer with my friends.
Nowadays, I am on the computer for a couple of hours every day.
It is a great way to talk to my friends about what we did
I exchange information about our homework, about other friends
and what is going on in the entertainment scene in Korea.
Also, I often do my homework on the computer.
Sometimes I watch TV or listen to music before I go to bed.
